verdict.description: Release ABBA shows substantially more continuous presentation, but net logical advancement remains about 31 Hz. Do not describe the 4x target as met.

measurement.order: A1 B1 B2 A2; all runs serialized; only P2 CPU throttled
measurement.definition: Net logic Hz is forward frame advancement divided by elapsed wall time; historical replay ticks do not count as new frames. Presentation gaps are RAF timestamps of callbacks with a new renderer Present count, not physical scanout. Completion gaps are separate.
measurement.statistics: Ranges below are the min/max of the two individual run statistics, not pooled percentiles or confidence intervals. Two runs per variant do not establish statistical significance. Closed-loop timing changes the actual number of corrections/resimulations.

rejected.candidate: B/C common TouchMany and bulk-copy prototype
rejected.reason: Measured live throughput regression; canonical eagler-common pin retained; isolated dirty prototype is not integrated.
Live run did not improve measured throughput; original O2 and floating-point flags retained.
Exact pixel checks found missing lines; replaced by separate line VAO with rebased attribute offsets in I/J.
Controlled tape run worsened logic and presentation metrics; source reverted to J.
Authored fixture probe found waveform/cursor differences; no cache integrated.
Coverage assertion did not reach results; original failure preserved and coverage completed by the passing 7200-frame run.

limitations: The 4x stable-60-Hz performance target is not met. Candidate still has >100 ms presentation gaps.
Desktop Chromium 153 with Intel UHD ANGLE D3D11; no phone, Safari, public Internet, RTC/TURN or physical scanout acceptance.
Real-relay ABBA measures 1800 logical input frames; two separate 7200-frame checks cover rollback correctness and production rendering, not 7200-frame real-relay 4x performance.
Input impairment is seeded application-send delay 39 +/- 5 ms; delivered delay is higher under event-loop load and is recorded separately.
Sampled nonzero SDL output blocks verify active audio output, not uninterrupted whole-stream or acoustic quality.

MA_SOUND_FLAG_NO_PITCH removes the old unity-rate pitch filter. At 44100 Hz waveform bytes intentionally differ; tested source PCM, cursors, loops, seek, pan, gain, stop/resume. Necessary 22050/48000 Hz resampling is retained.
Renderer queue reduces batch and buffer-replacement counts; vertex upload bytes rise about 0.49% in the 7200-frame full-render fixture. These counts are not proportional CPU-speedup claims.
The 2130-byte Replay comparison is the final saved recording after lifecycle transitions, not a claim that one Replay contains all 7200 test frames.
Portable renderer changes have TH09 and synthetic GLES coverage here; no full-game rebuild/acceptance for other titles.
